terra.problem: 1 Samuel 10:1 shows Samuel anointing Saul, not Israel’s first kings. The claim about multiple kings needs a reference that also includes David’s anointing.
The explanation says the family relationship is exactly why John spoke up. The text gives John’s words but does not state his reason for speaking.
The line about holding on for years implies a duration for Herodias’s grudge that the passage does not give.
“Still coming back for more” adds that Herod repeatedly returned to hear John. The passage says he listened gladly, but does not describe him returning.
“No pondering” claims the girl did not think about the request. The text says she hurried back, but does not say what she thought.
The snooze-button joke makes light of the girl’s haste to request John’s death.
